question: Why do some geologists start the Anthropocene around 1950–1960?
answer: Some geologists date the Anthropocene to around 1950–1960 because hydrogen-bomb tests in the 1950s and 60s spread a radioactive layer worldwide. That layer forms a clear marker in the mud everywhere. An era needs a mark found everywhere at once, and this one qualifies.
move: An era needs a mark found everywhere at once: the 1950s bomb fallout is one.
